_readme: The ending, said back in the village. The lantern is lit inside the keep, and the only
thing that makes it an ENDING is that the warden reads the flag it set - so the last
beat of the game changes someone the player already walked past twice.

see.speaker: Warden
see.text: There is a light in the keep. I can see it from here.

done.speaker: Warden
done.text: I have been the warden of a dark building for eleven years. Thank you for making it a lit one.
